caption: A streamlined car has a curved-roof cabin and four separate wheels. The cabin stands over the main body, while the wheels attach in front and rear pairs on its two sides. Rounded solid surfaces carry the connected parts. Across the whole car, width is about 0.68 of front-to-back length and height is about 0.69 of width. The body and cabin are red, the windows are light blue, and the four wheels are near black, with continuous color regions. A front view reveals the functional parts; side and overhead views show their depth, connections and arrangement.
